visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation opens in a minimalist bathroom with a soft light blue and teal color scheme. A small animated character wearing a yellow hooded sweatshirt and brown shorts stands atop a blue stool to reach the height of a white ceramic toilet. They are positioned to urinate while standing, looking directly into the bowl with a determined posture. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the character's face, which is round with large, wide eyes and a nervous, gritted-teeth expression. Pink blush marks on the cheeks indicate significant straining effort. The lighting is bright and flat, characteristic of a 2D digital animation style, with no complex shadows or textures. (3) A yellow sticky note is shown centered on the screen, featuring black hand-written text that says "SIT TO PEE! BABEE" alongside a simple drawing of a smiling face with mouse ears. The character is then shown again, now looking physically exhausted with droopy eyes and a single bead of sweat rolling down their face. (4) In a stylized dramatic sequence, a bright beam of white light shines down from above, highlighting the character while the rest of the background fades into a dark grey. The character assumes a smug, self-satisfied expression, closing their eyes and raising a hand as if they have cleverly circumvented the bathroom rules. (5) The peace is shattered as the toilet lid suddenly flies open from behind, accompanied by a massive splash of blue water that completely douses the character. A second character, wearing a dark grey mouse-eared costume with bright pink hair, emerges from within the toilet tank, screaming with an intensely angry facial expression. (6) The mouse-eared character, identified as Babee, stands menacingly on top of the toilet tank lid. They hold a yellow notepad and a pencil, looking down at the now-diminutive yellow character with a glare. The yellow character is shown sitting on the floor, appearing tiny and vulnerable compared to the rule-enforcing figure above. (7) Babee jumps down and slaps a yellow "SIT TO PEE" note directly onto the yellow character's forehead with a firm gesture. After flashing a peace sign, Babee retreats back into the tank and closes the lid. The final shot shows the yellow character sitting in shock on the teal floor, the note still stuck to their head.
